title: Permit Desk Fee Schedule for Reconstruction Contracts
content:
Permit, drawing, engineering, lead-safe and project management figures for each Reconstruction agreement, in US dollars unless a percentage or a year is shown.

| Agreement | Municipal permit fees billed at cost | Permit expediting fee, each permit | Plan drawing fee, per contract | Engineering letter fee, per letter | Project management fee | Lead-safe setup fee, per contract | RRP year-built cutoff |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repair Agreement - Minor Repairs | Yes | 95.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0% | 345.00 | 1978 |
| Standard Rebuild Agreement | Yes | 145.00 | 450.00 | 485.00 | 0% | 395.00 | 1978 |
| Major Rebuild Agreement | Yes | 185.00 | 850.00 | 485.00 | 0% | 495.00 | 1978 |
| Full Structural Rebuild Agreement | Yes | 245.00 | 1850.00 | 485.00 | 0% | 695.00 | 1978 |
| Multifamily Unit Rebuild Agreement | Yes | 145.00 | 650.00 | 485.00 | 0% | 395.00 | 1978 |
| Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement | Yes | 295.00 | 1450.00 | 685.00 | 4% | 0.00 | 1978 |

## Column meanings

- **Municipal permit fees billed at cost**: whether municipal permit fees are billed at cost to the customer.
- **Permit expediting fee**: the company fee for pulling and expediting each permit.
- **Plan drawing fee**: the fee for permit drawings when the work requires them, per contract.
- **Engineering letter fee**: the pass-through fee for a structural engineer's letter when framing is altered, per letter.
- **Project management fee**: the project management fee on the line-item total, as a percentage.
- **Lead-safe setup fee**: lead-safe work practice setup per contract.
- **RRP year-built cutoff**: housing built before this year triggers lead-safe practices when painted surfaces are disturbed (EPA RRP pre-1978 housing).

## Reading the schedule

On the Repair Agreement - Minor Repairs the plan drawing and engineering letter fees are 0.00, and on the Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement the lead-safe setup fee is 0.00. Only the Commercial Interior Rebuild Agreement carries a project management percentage (4%). The year-built cutoff is 1978 on every agreement, so a building built in 1977 is before the cutoff and one built in 1978 is not.
